sections.description:
A beautiful, fully-featured audio player for WordPress. Supports live radio streams, HLS, and a built-in file player with playlist, progress bar, and resume-from-last-position.

Two player modes: Live Stream (HLS, Shoutcast, Icecast, MP3/AAC/OGG with live now-playing metadata) and File Player (Media Library playlists with seek, 15-second skip, auto-advance, and resume). Six skins, custom gradients, dark mode, glassmorphism, multi-station support, and a fully interactive live admin preview.

Track artwork shows album art for the song currently playing. Where a stream supplies an image it is used directly; where it broadcasts only a title, the optional Track Artwork Lookup finds matching album artwork automatically. Any artwork can be tapped to open full size in a responsive lightbox.
sections.changelog:
3.11.0

  • NEW: Artwork lightbox — click or tap the player artwork to view it large in a responsive modal. Shows the current track artwork where one is displayed, otherwise the station's full-size logo, with the track or station name as a caption.
  • Modal closes via the close button, backdrop click, or Escape; fully keyboard accessible with focus handling, and honours prefers-reduced-motion.
  • Station artwork is now also stored at full size so the enlarged view is sharp rather than an upscaled thumbnail.
  • Updated 24-page user guide PDF covering track artwork, the lightbox and proxy settings.

3.10.3

  • FIX: Station artwork failing to change in the multi-station player when an image optimisation plugin is active. Such plugins add a srcset or wrap images in picture elements, which browsers prioritise over src, so the player's artwork swap updated an attribute the browser was ignoring. All artwork changes now clear srcset, sizes, lazy-load attributes and any picture sources.
  • Logged-in administrators are now exempt from the metadata rate limiter, so site testing can no longer lock out metadata for an hour.

3.10.2

  • FIX: Stations that broadcast a website link instead of an image in the stream's artwork field no longer suppress artwork. The URL is now validated as a real image before use; if it isn't one, Track Artwork Lookup fills the gap instead.
  • Artwork URLs without a file extension are verified by content type, with the result cached for 6 hours.

3.10.1

  • Station artwork in the multi-station switcher now uses the medium image size to match the player panel.

3.10.0

  • NEW: Track Artwork Lookup (opt-in, Proxy Settings page) — when a stream broadcasts the track title but no artwork, the server looks up album artwork from the iTunes Search API and displays it in the player. Cached per track, at most one lookup per song, no visitor data ever sent.
  • NEW: Track artwork now displays in the embedded, multi-station, and sticky players (previously only the pop-out player supported it).
  • FIX: Broken artwork placeholder could appear when a stream sent no artwork URL — inactive artwork is now guaranteed hidden, protected against lazy-load plugins, and hidden automatically if the image fails to load.
  • FIX: Multi-station artwork fallback — when a station has no track artwork, the station logo from settings now reliably shows; switching stations can no longer display a stale logo from the previous station.
  • Default skin: artwork enlarged to 100x100 and raised, with extra bottom padding so the metadata bar sits fully clear on desktop and mobile.

3.9.27

  • Maintenance release.
  • Self-hosted updates now delivered via Plugin Update Checker 5.7, with the update manifest served from GitHub for reliable, cache-proof update detection.
